_comment: Canonical mutate scope for the backend policy-layer mutation gate (ADR 0045 §2). The single source of truth for WHAT PIT mutates, read by BOTH build.gradle.kts (the pitest{} block, the mutator) AND a scripts/ meta-check (the guard that asserts something was in fact mutated) — Gradle-Kotlin-DSL and Python cannot parse each other's config, so a restated scope would drift the mutator and its guard apart (mirrors web/stryker.mutate.json). PIT class-glob syntax. An EXPLICIT list, never a package sweep: ADR 0045 §2 mutates the curated pure-decision tier only — never the dumb stores (a wrong WHERE is a real-DB test, not a mutant) nor the @QuarkusTest slices (integration-level mutation conflates wiring with assertion strength).
